{{Top|leg}}
Wigglewood was a type of wood which grew on the Forest Moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The Ewok Teebo crash landed into a thicket of wigglewood after a Mantigrue attacked his glider and damaged it, causing it to lose altitude and fall.<ref name="A Tale of Magic and Suspense">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref>
